nativeCaptions.KR_CINE_AX_ACT_BRAVERY_001_SOLOHO: Soloho: This is the test of courage.

strings.KR_SH_TUT_001: Betty: Nathan, the Cajuns hid Pandora on the island ahead. Follow me.
strings.KR_SH_TUT_002: Betty: Almost there. Check your machine guns for any jams.
strings.KR_SH_TUT_003: Betty: Shoot a few of the big balloons in front of you.
